nodes.speaker: psy
nodes.text: Four astronauts in a tiny capsule for days. Tempers are getting short.

variants.text: Everyone is cranky after the rushed launch, and the capsule is tiny. Tempers are short.
The pre-launch rest paid off and spirits are good. Still, the capsule is tiny.

nodes.fact: Orion's living space is about 9 cubic meters, about the inside of a small camper van, shared by four astronauts.

nodes.speaker: ops
nodes.text: We're drifting 40 km off course. A small engine burn can fix it.

variants.text: That short burn left us 300 km off course. We need a bigger correction.

nodes.fact: Spacecraft on the way to the Moon make small course-correction burns. Apollo crews did a few each trip.

nodes.speaker: ops
nodes.text: Lunar orbit insertion: the engine fires behind the Moon, where Earth cannot hear us.
nodes.fact: Apollo and Artemis capsules slow down with a burn behind the Moon, out of radio contact, so lunar gravity can capture them.
